command: CUDACXX=/usr/local/cuda-13.3/bin/nvcc CUDAToolkit_ROOT=/usr/local/cuda-13.3 VULKAN_SDK=/home/marcel/Programs/VulkanSDK/1.4.341.1 cmake -S . -B build/release -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/gcc-15 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-15 -DCMAKE_CUDA_HOST_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-15 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DNR_CUDA_ARCH=89 -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON && cmake --build build/release --target NoorRay -j$(nproc)
